UP Election: Parties React to Candidate Lists and Yogi Adityanath

Ahead of Uttar Pradesh elections, a list of BJP candidates has caused controversy. Separately, Samajwadi Party leader Akhilesh Yadav led a 20km Rath Yatra in Gorakhpur. Chandra Shekhar Aazad of Nagina MP welcomed potential allies for a common alternative, stating Akhilesh Yadav must prove his popularity by contesting against Yogi Adityanath. A figure referred to as 'Baal Yogi' has reportedly joined the Samajwadi Party and vowed to defeat CM Yogi.
